answer: Your records don't list any allergies. There are no allergy or intolerance entries at all, in any of the records I have. That is not the same as a confirmed 'no known allergies', because I can't see a note saying that either. Please check with your doctor or pharmacy, especially if you have ever had a reaction to a medicine, food or contrast dye. You did have a contrast CT scan in July 2025 and the records show no reaction, but they also don't say one way or the other.
short: No allergies are recorded in her records, but there is also no entry saying 'no known allergies', so this needs confirming with her doctor.
